text:
Good evening lounge team,
Mixed spell behind us, one thing is left: handler training

Thanks for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady through a busy stretch. I know the lounge side had a lot of moving parts, but the care you gave to each family made a real difference. The pet area for Brightwater is set up with its own clear process, and that helps us keep arrivals calm and organized. Please keep giving passengers simple guidance before departure, and keep flagging anything that could affect a safe handoff.

<<FACT F044>> We also need to stay alert on the small details that matter most, because every animal comes with its own comfort needs and every traveler deserves a clear, kind update. If a passenger seems worried, take the extra moment to listen closely and pass the note along to the supervisor without delay. The safety coordinator will keep reviewing hazards and prevention, but the warm welcome from the desk is just as important as the checks behind it. When the team stays patient and consistent, even a tense transfer can feel manageable.

If you are covering the lounge, please make sure the handover notes stay current and the pet carriers are placed where staff can reach them easily. A calm tone, steady eye contact, and a quick check of the booking details go a long way. Thanks again for the care you bring to Aurelia Skyways and to every companion animal that passes through our doors. Let us keep the standard high and the service kind.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
